name: Shenzhen Success Electronics Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Success Electronics Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of LCD displays and modules, touch screens and modules, and touch display integrated modules in China and internationally. It offers TN, HTN, STN, CSTN, and TFT LCDs; and GFF, OGS, and GG capacitive touch screens. The company also provides a range of touch display integrated solutions for smart phone manufacturers. In addition, it offers instrumentation, security equipment, and electrical equipment.
